nodes.description: ValidatorProxy.implementation: address of the validator logic contract used as the delegatecall target of the proxy.
ValidatorProxy.operator: address of the operator owning this validator proxy.
ValidatorProxy.validatorFactory: address of the factory allowed to reconfigure this proxy.
Ownable._owner: private owner address, written only through _transferOwnership.
ValidatorProxy.setValidatorImplementation(address): external, guarded by isValidatorFactory, rewrites the implementation slot.
ValidatorProxy.setOperator(address): external, guarded by isValidatorFactory, rewrites the operator slot.
ValidatorProxy._implementation(): internal view override returning the implementation state variable to the Proxy logic.
ValidatorProxy constructor: initialises implementation, operator and validatorFactory.
Modifier isValidatorFactory: requires msg.sender == validatorFactory before executing the guarded external setters.
Proxy._delegate(address): internal assembly routine performing delegatecall with caller calldata and forwarding returndata.
Proxy._fallback(): internal hook that calls _beforeFallback and then _delegate(_implementation()).
Proxy.fallback(): external payable entrypoint delegating unmatched calldata to the implementation.
Proxy.receive(): external payable entrypoint delegating empty calldata to the implementation.
Proxy._beforeFallback(): virtual hook executed before delegation.
Ownable.owner(): public view returning the current owner.
Modifier onlyOwner: requires owner() == _msgSender() before executing the guarded function.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): public onlyOwner function setting the owner to address(0).
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): public onlyOwner function forwarding to _transferOwnership.
Ownable._transferOwnership(address): internal unrestricted ownership transfer writing _owner.
Context._msgSender(): internal view returning msg.sender.
Attacker-controlled caller address used in the isValidatorFactory and onlyOwner authorisation checks.
Inline-assembly delegatecall inside Proxy._delegate: executes arbitrary code of the implementation address in the proxy storage context.
Parameter of setValidatorImplementation, attacker-influenced only if the caller is the validator factory; written into the implementation slot.
Parameter of setOperator, written into the operator slot after the isValidatorFactory check.
Constructor parameter initialising the implementation state variable.
Constructor parameter initialising the operator state variable.
Constructor parameter initialising the validatorFactory state variable used for access control.
Parameter 'implementation' of Proxy._delegate holding the delegatecall target address.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership, forwarded to _transferOwnership.
Parameter newOwner of _transferOwnership, assigned to the _owner state variable.
Local variable in _transferOwnership caching the previous owner before the ownership update.

edges.reason: The validated setValidatorImplementation argument is stored into the implementation state variable.
The validated setOperator argument is stored into the operator state variable.
Constructor parameter _newImplementation initialises the implementation state variable.
Constructor parameter _operator initialises the operator state variable.
Constructor parameter _validatorFactory initialises the validatorFactory state variable.
msg.sender is compared against validatorFactory inside the isValidatorFactory modifier, so the caller controls whether the guard passes.
isValidatorFactory guards execution of setValidatorImplementation, the only path that rewrites the implementation slot.
isValidatorFactory guards execution of setOperator, the only path that rewrites the operator slot.
onlyOwner evaluates msg.sender through _msgSender, making the caller the controlling input of the authorisation branch.
Context._msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller into all authorisation logic.
_msgSender is consumed by the onlyOwner require statement to compare against owner().
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership, restricting ownership renouncement to the current owner.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership, restricting ownership transfer to the current owner.
owner() is read inside the onlyOwner modifier to compare against the caller.
transferOwnership forwards the validated newOwner to _transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership calls _transferOwnership with address(0).
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner flows into _transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter of _transferOwnership is assigned to _owner.
The current _owner is read into the oldOwner local variable before the ownership update.
_fallback delegates execution to _delegate with the resolved implementation address.
fallback() routes unmatched calldata into _fallback.
receive() routes empty calldata into _fallback.
_fallback invokes the _beforeFallback hook before delegating.
_fallback obtains the delegatecall target from _implementation().
_implementation returns the implementation state variable as the delegation target.
The implementation address parameter flows into the delegatecall performed by _delegate.
_delegate performs a delegatecall that hands control to the implementation contract, which can re-enter the proxy before state is finalised.
The address produced by _implementation is consumed as the delegatecall target inside _delegate.
The implementation state variable directly determines the target of the delegatecall unsafe operation executed on every fallback/receive call.

normalization_plan.reason: _newValidatorImplementation is a parameter only used to write a state variable inside setValidatorImplementation, so it can be folded into that core function node.
_newOperator is a parameter whose sole effect is the operator slot write inside setOperator, so it merges into that function node.
_newImplementation is a constructor parameter used only for the implementation assignment, so it is absorbed by the constructor node.
_operator is a constructor parameter used only for the operator assignment, so it is absorbed by the constructor node.
_validatorFactory is a constructor parameter used only for the validatorFactory assignment, so it is absorbed by the constructor node.
The implementation parameter exists only to supply the delegatecall target inside _delegate and is merged into that function node.
newOwner of transferOwnership is a transient argument forwarded to _transferOwnership and is merged into the transferOwnership function node.
newOwner of _transferOwnership is used only for the _owner write inside that function, so it is merged into _transferOwnership.
oldOwner is a local temporary that only mirrors the _owner read inside _transferOwnership and can be merged into that core function.
